name: Indurium Ore
summary: Pozzik needs Indurium Ore to build several parts for the racers. The ore lies at the Uldaman dig in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan. Gnomes are already gathering their own supply, and Pozzik wants to keep pace.

sections.title: Ore from Uldaman
sections.body: Pozzik asks you to bring him four pieces of raw Indurium Ore. You can find it at the Uldaman dig in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan. Gnomes are already gathering their own supply, and Pozzik wants some too. This comes after Rizzle's Schematics.

faq.q: Why does Pozzik want indurium ore?
faq.answer: Pozzik needs a great deal of raw Indurium Ore for several parts of the racers.

faq.q: Where is the indurium ore found?
aliases: where do i get indurium ore
faq.answer: Indurium Ore comes from the Uldaman dig site in the Badlands, over the sea in Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Why does it matter to get the ore?
faq.answer: Gnomes are already gathering their own Indurium Ore, and Pozzik wants to keep pace.
Rizzle's Schematics comes before this, and Keeping Pace comes before Rizzle's Schematics.
